name: Multi-agent architecture
short_description: An AI solution design in which several agents each have their own scope, instructions and tools, typically with a front agent that routes requests to specialized agents.

evidence.quote: Because now, we are more in a multi-agent model, where each agent has a scope and is responsibilities.
